title: Mcopy (staff)
body:
Syntax: mcopy <source mob vnum> <new mob vnum>

Description: Copies a mob prototype, including its stats, flags, shop stock, and programs, to an unused VNUM. The copy is independent of the original. It is not spawned or given a spawn point; use 'minvoke' or 'spawnpoint add mob' when ready. Inspect it with 'mstat'.

Date: 2026-09-25
